inclusions: Accommodation as per the choice of hotels/ stays
Driver's Night Allowance, Inter State tax, and fuel charges
Meet, Greet & Assistance if required at destinations

days.title: Day 1 – Rajkot to Dwarka
activities: En route visit Bala Hanuman Temple, Jamnagar (subject to time availability).
Arrive in Dwarka and check in to the hotel.
Visit Gomti Ghat and Sudama Setu.
Attend evening Aarti at Dwarkadhish Temple.

days.title: Day 2 – Dwarka Local Sightseeing
activities: Early morning darshan at Dwarkadhish Temple.
Proceed towards Okha and take a ferry to Bet Dwarka.
Visit Gopi Talav, subject to time availability.

days.title: Day 3 – Dwarka to Somnath via Porbandar
activities: Breakfast and check out from the hotel.
Arrive in Somnath and check in to the hotel.
Attend evening Aarti at Somnath Temple.
Attend Light and Sound Show, subject to availability.

days.title: Day 4 – Somnath to Rajkot | Departure
activities: Early morning darshan at Somnath Jyotirlinga Temple.
Breakfast and check out from the hotel.
Drop at Rajkot Airport/Railway Station for onward journey.
